premises.name: Pinned Fresnel--Brascamp--Lieb Theorem F
premises.scope_used: Exact rank-three physical frame, row leverage at most 1/2, arbitrary independent cap-one physical inputs, no residual quadratic block; linear terms allowed. Used only for the common |t|^{-3/2} output characteristic-function envelope.

premises.name: account02/B17 QFORM-GROWING-DIRECTION-UNIFORM-CONVOLUTION-BARRIER-v1
premises.scope_used: Tetrahedral vanishing-leverage carrier with one independent unit-uniform convolution component in every physical coordinate; arbitrary independent additive noises and rotations; gives density <=3sqrt(2)+14.51216338024275... epsilon_K^(1/3), epsilon_K->0.

new_result.name: QFORM-MICROCOMB-NO-FIXED-CARRIER-SHARP-WITNESS-v1
new_result.statement: There is an exact entrywise-dense rank-three target sequence A_m with active spectrum {1,1,-1} and independent cap-one micro-comb marginals f_m having m support components and no independent uniform convolution factor of any fixed positive width, for which ||p_{X^T A_m X}||_infinity ->3sqrt(2).
new_result.carrier_exclusion: Every support component has length 1/m; any independent uniform carrier of width ell forces an essential-support interval of length ell, hence ell<=1/m for this law.

partner_result_applied.family: Same dense tetrahedral A_m with physical Xtilde_{m,i}=U_i+m C_i, U_i unit-uniform and C_i iid standard Cauchy.

unresolved_implication: The result does not prove C_univ=3sqrt(2) or the universal theorem. A possible overshoot must use genuinely non-diffuse rough arrays before aggregation, macroscopic components coupled to a rough residual rather than a pure shift, or additional active spectrum interacting before rank-three aggregation.
next_step: Stress rough cap-one triangular arrays with no positive-width carrier whose aggregated active law is non-Gaussian/non-Lindeberg; seek either a peak above 3sqrt(2) or a product-preserving anti-spike theorem covering that class.
